snippet.title: Air Aces Pacific
snippet.description: To have the graphics look unlike any game before, Air Aces: Pacific harness an OBE Game Engine by D6Team supported by openGL basics with some adjustments. If you take a closer look on the graphic during pretty days in paradise and murky nights full of heavy rain and lighting you will almost see a brush moving and painting everything you can see on the screen.
